subject.title: [Bug]: Origin validation fails for custom URL schemes (tauri://, electron://)

question: Which exact custom-scheme origin fix path should maintainers advance for this Gateway origin-authorization bug?
rationale: The issue is source-reproducible and security-relevant, but two open PRs target the same authorization helper and maintainers need to pick or sponsor the canonical path before this issue can close.

options.title: Advance one exact-origin PR
options.body: Pick the cleaner current-main candidate, require or explicitly override real behavior proof for the auth boundary, and close sibling attempts after merge.

options.title: Pause for broader origin policy
options.body: Defer the exact custom-scheme bug until maintainers decide the broader wildcard or pattern policy, leaving affected users on the wildcard workaround longer.

options.title: Close without fixing
options.body: Reject custom-scheme exact allowlisting and document wildcard or native-hosting alternatives, accepting the security and usability tradeoff.

recommendation.title: Advance one exact-origin PR
recommendation.body: Pick the cleaner current-main candidate, require or explicitly override real behavior proof for the auth boundary, and close sibling attempts after merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and hardened the Gateway origin-check surface and is the strongest history-backed owner for the security-boundary decision.
